newsitem.title: USA: FBI says to search Columbia/HCA sites in 6 states.
newsitem.headline: FBI says to search Columbia/HCA sites in 6 states.

text.p: The Federal Bureau of Investigation said on Wednesday it executed search warrants on Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp sites in six states.
Earlier today, Columbia/HCA said in a statement that the FBI served search warrants in five states -- Florida, Texas, Tennessee, North Carolina and Utah.
The FBI said this afternoon that warrants were also executed on sites in Oklahoma.
Jule Miller, an FBI spokesperson in Washington, said, "We've confirmed agents have executed 35 court authorized search warrants in six states."
Miller said no other information was available because the affidavit in support of the search warrants was under a court seal.

Columbia/HCA said in its earlier statement that it believes the warrants "requested various records and documents primarily in two separate areas: hospital laboratory billing and homecare operations."

It was not immediately clear if the search warrants served Wednesday were related to search warrants served in March at Columbia/HCA's El Paso, Texas, site, or to subsequent news reports about federal probes into other operations.
